sections.heading: How to Play Frost
sections.body:
[h2 type=bar toc="How to Play Frost"][color=c6]Frost Death Knight Rotation in Midnight Season 2[/color][/h2]
Frost's rotation is about spending procs and managing resources. It does not follow a strict builder/spender pattern, as both of its resources are used to generate each other.

[wrapper width=1100px][box border=true]
[center][table style=grid]
[tr][td]
[table]
	[tr]
	[td width=6%][icon name=inv_sword_122 size=medium type=round color=c6 inline=true][/icon][/td]
	[td][b][color=c6]Spend Killing Machine:[/color][/b] [spell=51128] is the foundation for all our damage. In addition to a guaranteed crit, it also triggers effects like [spell=456230], [spell=377098], and [spell=1230153].
	[/td][/tr]
[/table]
[hr]
[table]
	[tr]
	[td width=6%][icon name=spell_frost_freezingbreath size=medium type=round color=c6 inline=true][/icon][/td]
	[td][b][color=c6]Spend Rime:[/color][/b] Cast [spell=49184] with [spell=59057] as much as possible. Rime triggers [spell=1238680] to recover [spell=47568] faster, granting more Killing Machine procs. 
	[/td][/tr]
[/table]
[hr]
[table]
	[tr]
	[td width=6%][icon name=ability_deathknight_pillaroffrost size=medium type=round color=c6 inline=true][/icon][/td]
	[td][b][color=c6]Use Pillar of Frost off cooldown:[/color][/b] [spell=51271] has a relatively short cooldown and should not be held to avoid losing casts.[/td]
	[/tr]
[/table]
[/td][/tr][/table]
[/center]
[/box][/wrapper]
[pad]
[center][cta-button guide=32899 icon=spell_deathknight_frostpresence]Frost Death Knight Starter Guide[/cta-button][/center]

sections.heading: Major Cooldowns
sections.body:
[h2 toc="Major Cooldowns" type=bar][color=c6][icon name=spell_deathknight_frostpresence type=round size=medium inline=true color=c6][/icon] Frost Death Knight Major Cooldowns[/color][/h2]
Frost only has a few major cooldowns. They should be used alongside each other as much as possible. You never want to use one on its own. Frost's cooldowns require little setup and planning, but there are a few interactions between them to consider.

[pad]
[tabs name="cds" uniform=true iconborders=true]

[tab name="Pillar of Frost" icon=ability_deathknight_pillaroffrost]
	[h3 type=bar toc=false][color=c6]Pillar of Frost[/color][/h3]
	[spell=51271] is extremely simple by itself, but it serves as an activator for some important effects. 

  The most important is [spell=281238], which alters the feel of the rotation while Pillar of Frost is active. The overall priority does not change, but you will notice that during Pillar of Frost you are pressing [spell=49020] more often to keep spending [spell=51124 buff=true]. [spell=377226] does not impact your rotation, but it is important to be aware that it makes [spell=196770] an automatic passive, so we still take talents that buff it in AoE builds.
[/tab]

[tab name="Frostwyrm's Fury" icon=achievement_boss_sindragosa]
	[h3 type=bar toc=false][color=c6]Frostwyrm's Fury[/color][/h3]

  [spell=279302] is integral to Frost in Midnight, thanks for the Apex talents. The most important thing to know is to never cast Frostwyrm's Fury without [spell=51271], otherwise you will waste [spell=1265633].

  [span display-options="deathbringer"][symbol=wow-hero-talent-deathbringer] [color=#9BE2E2]Deathbringer[/color] can use Frostwyrm's Fury immediately after pressing Pillar of Frost. The recall cast can be saved for the best opportunity you can find during Pillar of Frost. This will be when either you get the best buff overlap, or when you can hit the most targets.[/span]
  
  [span display-options="rider-of-the-apocalypse"][symbol=wow-hero-talent-rider-of-the-apocalypse] [color=#5AFFA2]Rider of the Apocalypse[/color] wants to use Frostwyrm's Fury as soon as possible after Pillar of Frost. Frostwyrm's Fury summons all the Horsemen through [spell=444040], meaning [spell=444763 buff=true] is active. We want to overlap it with Pillar of Frost's strength buff to keep our Strength as high as possible as long as possible.[/span]
[/tab]

[tab name="Reaper's Mark" icon=inv_ability_deathbringerdeathknight_reapersmark]
	[h3 type=bar toc=false][color=c6]Reaper's Mark[/color][/h3]
	 [spell=439843] is used on cooldown, on the same GCD as [spell=51271] if it is available. Pairing with Pillar of Frost is especially important in AoE to overlap the Strength buff with the hits from [spell=439851]. Ensure your target does not already have  Reaper's Mark when carrying an [spell=441378] into a new pack. Applying Reaper's Mark to a target that already has it will prematurely end the existing mark.
[/tab]

[/tabs]

sections.heading: Advanced Tips
sections.body:
[h2 toc="Advanced Tips" type=bar][color=c6][icon name=Inv_artifact_tome01 type=round size=medium inline=true color=c6][/icon] Frost Death Knight Advanced Tips[/color][/h2]

[pad]

[tabs name="advanced" uniform=true iconborders=true]
[tab name="Killing Streak" icon=ability_creature_cursed_05]
	[h3 type=bar toc=false][color=c6]Understanding Killing Streak[/color][/h3]
	[spell=1230153] poses an important question: should I intentionally wait for two stacks of [spell=51128]? The short answer is no. Killing Machine stacks to two to give us some rotational breathing room, but do not try to intentionally go to two stacks.

Frost wants to spend as many GCDs as possible on spending Killing Machine, and as few GCDs as possible on casting [spell=49020]/[spell=207230] without Killing Machine. Obliterate deals over double its normal damage with Killing Machine, and Frostscythe deals four times its normal damage. You deal more damage overall by spending two single Killing Machine abilities than by consuming double Killing Machine. The bonus crit damage from Killing Streak is not nearly as much as the difference between an unbuffed hit and a hit buffed by Killing Machine. 
[/tab]
[/tabs]
[pad]

Our Frost Death Knight guides are always updated with the latest information from in-game experience, simulations, and logs. Make sure to check our changelog for this page by clicking on [b]View Changelog[/b] in the Quick Facts column or on the book icon at the top of the page. If you are interested in more in-depth Frost Death Knight guides for [b]Midnight Season 2[/b], make sure to browse the [i]Navigation Bar[/i] at the top of the page, along with our list of [b]Related Guides[/b] just beneath the [i]Table of Contents[/i].
